title: Tweakie
description: Adds lots of Quality of Life texture tweaks to make your gameplay better.
body:
# 🌟 Tweakie

A comprehensive resource pack for Minecraft 1.21.1 designed to clean up the world, enhance block readability, and add striking visual overhauls to your survival and competitive gameplay. 

![All Changes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa3927b1f702a650399349b8eed0d9255a1a21ff.png)

---

## ✨ Features

### 🌱 World & Environment
* **5-Sided Grass Blocks:** Enjoy seamless lush landscapes with grass completely covering all sides of the block.
* **Mushroom Island Vibrancy:** Experience a completely custom foliage and grass gradient texture inspired by the lime tones of Mushroom Fields.
* **Cleaner Terrain:** No more random pebbles in any variants of Dirt blocks for a much smoother surface look.
* **Simpler Bedrock:** A cleaner, less noisy, stone-like texture for bedrock at the bottom of the world.

### 🔍 Utility & Readability
* **Ore & Amethyst Outlines:** Easily spot vital resources with distinct borders on all ores and Budding Amethyst *(Note: No glowing effect)*.
* **Stone Variant Outlines:** Clear outlines for Andesite, Granite, and Diorite to help you distinguish block types instantly while mining.
* **Obvious Powder Snow:** Never fall into hidden traps again with a highly visible, distinct texture for dangerous snow blocks.
* **Suspicious Block Highlighting:** Hard-to-spot Suspicious Gravel and Suspicious Sand are now much more obvious for easier archeology.
* **No Spyglass Overlay:** Removes the vignette when looking through the Spyglass *(Note: Your screen still becomes 1:1 resolution with its use)*.

### 📦 Blocks & Redstone
* **Full Beehive Notifier:** Instantly see when Beehives and Bee Nests are full of honey and ready for harvest.
* **Trapped Chest Warning:** Trapped Chests now feature a bold red accent to prevent accidental explosions or traps.
* **Pink Tripwire:** String placed on the ground is now bright pink, making tripwire traps highly visible.
* **Plain Building Blocks:** Completely smooth, plain textures for Hay Bales and Dried Kelp Blocks.
* **Simpler Redstone Lamps:** A cleaner, less cluttered texture for both toggled states of the lamp.
* **Plain Redstone Lines:** Flat and straightforward redstone wire textures for easier wiring tracking.

### 💎 Items & Gear
* **Blue Ancient Debris:** Replaces the muddy brown Netherite ore color with a striking, easily recognizable blue.
* **Blue Golden Apple:** A mythical twist on the classic enchanted fruit.
* **Experience Splash Bottle:** Retextured Experience Bottles to look like splash potions.
* **Flint Arrows:** Arrow item textures now accurately represent the flint used to craft them.
* **Better Leather:** A brown refined item texture for standard leather.
* **Bamboo Scaffolding:** Accurate texture for scaffolding.
